title: Optional: cancel a goal
description: Send a two-metre goal, then cancel it after feedback reports more than 0.3 m. Wait for cancellation to finish.
steps: Reuse the previous action client and retain its accepted goal handle.
In the feedback callback, cancel once when distance_travelled exceeds 0.3.
Inspect the final result: status 5 means cancelled. The robot should stop before completing two metres.
hints: Cancelling is a request; observe the final action result too.
Use a boolean to avoid sending the cancellation on every feedback event.
handle.cancel_goal_async() requests cancellation; keep the result callback from the previous lab.

de.title: Optional: ein Ziel abbrechen

steps: Riusa il client precedente e conserva il goal handle accettato.
Nel callback di feedback annulla una sola volta quando distance_travelled supera 0.3.

hints: L’annullamento è una richiesta; osserva anche il risultato finale.
Usa un booleano per non annullare a ogni messaggio di feedback.
handle.cancel_goal_async() richiede l’annullamento; conserva il callback del risultato dell’esercizio precedente.

content.title: Optional: cancel a goal
content.description: Send a two-metre goal, then cancel it after feedback reports more than 0.3 m. Wait for cancellation to finish.
steps: Retain the accepted GoalHandle::SharedPtr in goal_response_callback. Send a two-metre goal.
In feedback_callback, request client->async_cancel_goal(handle) once after distance_travelled exceeds 0.3 m.
Wait for result.code == rclcpp_action::ResultCode::CANCELED and verify that the robot stops before two metres.
hints: A cancellation request is not the final result; keep the result callback.
Use a boolean to prevent repeated cancellation requests.
Retain the goal handle after acceptance; set the boolean before calling async_cancel_goal.

nl.title: Optioneel: annuleer een doel

Vraag in feedback_callback één keer client->async_cancel_goal(handle) aan zodra distance_travelled groter is dan 0.3 m.
Wacht op result.code == rclcpp_action::ResultCode::CANCELED en controleer dat de robot vóór twee meter stopt.
hints: Een annuleringsverzoek is niet het eindresultaat; behoud de resultaatcallback.
Gebruik een boolean om herhaalde annuleringsverzoeken te voorkomen.
Bewaar de goal handle na acceptatie; stel de boolean in vóór async_cancel_goal.
